title: Radial Ring
description: A home-screen launcher that winds eight apps around a dial; `itemAnimation` maps each item's value to an angle.
steps: `itemSize` 60 means every 60 pt of drag turns the dial 45°, and `autoplay` with `autoplayInterval` 2000 keeps it turning.
`translateX` = R·sin(value·45°) and `translateY` = −R·cos(value·45°) with R = 0.38 × width put 8 apps on one circle, with the top icon at `scale` 1.3 and the rest fading to opacity 0.45.
`progress` names the app in the hub, and tapping an icon or widget calls `scrollTo({ index })` to turn it to the top.
